# Receipt intake settings

> Supplies the deployment-configured archive and confirmation e-mail settings for receipt intake.

- **System:** [receipt-intake](../index.md#receipt-intake)
- **Caller:** Internal — the caller is inside the trust boundary
- **Blast radius:** Medium
- **Source:** [`intake_settings.yamlet.yaml`](../../../../../specs_example/intake_settings.yamlet.yaml)

The configuration source of the receipt intake: it holds the archive address and the fixed subjects and bodies of the archive and confirmation e-mails, and hands them to whatever wires it. It exists so these values are wired from a component the deployment controls, never supplied by the submitter at the external boundary.

## Contract

`intake-settings` — supply the configured archive and confirmation e-mail settings

- **Inputs:** none
- **Outputs:** `archive_address`, `archive_subject`, `archive_body`, `confirmation_subject`, `confirmation_body`

## Requirements

<a id="rq-1"></a>

### RQ-1 · The configured e-mail settings are supplied to the intake exactly as deployed

<a id="ac-1"></a>
**AC-1** · When the intake settings are read, the system shall:

- return the deployed archive e-mail address as `archive_address`
- return the deployed archive subject and body as `archive_subject` and `archive_body`
- return the deployed confirmation subject and body as `confirmation_subject` and `confirmation_body`

<a id="ac-2"></a>
**AC-2** · If a setting has no deployed value, then the system shall:

- refuse to supply any setting

## Used by

- [Receipt submission portal](receipt_portal.md) as `settings`
